paragraphs.text: Junk is a predefined token and artifact type introduced in Universes Beyond : Fallout .

Each Junk token has the artifact subtype “Junk” and the ability “ : Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.” This is an impulsive draw effect.
The token was designed to capture the use of Junk in the Fallout series, where miscellaneous items can be turned into useful or interesting contraptions.

According to Mark Rosewater , Junk tokens are likely to be tweaked if they return. They would need an activation cost to better balance them. Without one, it is generally easy to convert it directly to a card via its ability, as opposed to most impulsive draw effects. As it was introduced in a preconstructed product, the mana efficiency and rate of production is less clear compared to clues, another card-equivalent token.
